overview: Incremental protocol mapping for the pre-release JAR. Protocol version remains 2 but build number jumped from 20 to 51. Total registered packets increased from 268 to 280 (+12). Struct count 339->343 (+4). Enum count 137->142 (+5). Major additions: voice chat system (new 'voice' sub-package + Voice network channel), emote system, stream negotiation, connection packet split (Disconnect -> ClientDisconnect + ServerDisconnect), and enriched item/block definitions. Files read: 785 protocol .java files in pre-release.

root_package.name: ConditionalBlockSound
root_package.description: New fixed-size struct linking a sound event to an ambience FX condition. Used in the new BlockType.conditionalSounds array field.

root_package.name: DebugFlags
root_package.description: New enum for debug rendering flags controlling fade, wireframe, and solid rendering modes.

root_package.name: FormattedMessageImage
root_package.description: New struct for embedding images in formatted messages. Contains file path and dimensions.

root_package.name: ItemHudUI
root_package.description: New struct defining HUD UI elements attached to items. Can reference a UI definition by path.

root_package.name: ItemHudUIType
root_package.description: New enum distinguishing between HUD overlay and legend UI types for items.

root_package.name: ProtocolEmote
root_package.description: New struct defining an emote: identity, display name, animation reference, icon, and looping flag. Carried in UpdateEmotes packet.

root_package.name: SubCategoryDefinition
root_package.description: New struct for item sub-category definitions with id, display name, description, and sort order. Referenced by the new ItemBase.subCategory field and ItemCategory changes.

voice.description: Entirely new sub-package for voice chat. Four types, three are packets. Uses new Voice NetworkChannel.

types.name: VoiceData
types.description: Client sends Opus-encoded voice audio data to server. Max 512 bytes of opus data per frame.

types.name: RelayedVoiceData
types.description: Server relays voice data from a speaker to nearby listeners. Includes 3D position for spatial audio and underwater flag for audio effects.

types.name: VoiceConfig
types.description: Server configures voice chat parameters: codec, sample rate, spatial audio distances, and rate limiting.

types.name: VoiceCodec
types.description: Codec enum for voice chat. Currently only Opus.

stream.description: Entirely new sub-package for QUIC stream negotiation. Three types.

types.name: StreamOpen
types.description: Client requests opening a new QUIC stream of the given type.

types.name: StreamOpenResponse
types.description: Server responds to stream open request with accept/reject and optional rejection reason.

types.name: StreamType
types.description: Logical stream types: Game (default) or Voice (requires stream negotiation).

connection.description: Connection packet restructuring: single Disconnect split into direction-specific packets with richer types.

types.name: ClientDisconnect
types.description: Client-to-server disconnect. Replaces the 'Both' direction Disconnect(id=1). Now includes structured ClientDisconnectReason.

types.name: ServerDisconnect
types.description: Server-to-client disconnect. Replaces old Disconnect for ToClient direction. Uses FormattedMessage instead of plain String for rich-text disconnect messages.

types.name: ClientDisconnectReason
types.description: New enum distinguishing client disconnect causes: normal leave, abort, user-initiated leave, or crash.

types.name: QuicApplicationErrorCode
types.description: New protocol-level enum for QUIC application error codes. Previously these were int constants in ProtocolUtil; now formally part of the protocol schema.

entities.name: PlayEmote
entities.description: Client requests playing an emote by ID. Part of the new emote system.

assets.name: UpdateEmotes
assets.description: Server sends emote definitions to client. Uses Init/AddOrUpdate/Remove update type pattern like other asset packets.

asseteditor.name: AssetEditorModsDirectories
asseteditor.description: New packet sending mod directory listings to the asset editor client.

buildertools.name: BuilderToolResetClipboardRotation
buildertools.description: Empty packet. Client requests clipboard rotation reset.

buildertools.name: ClipboardEntityChange
buildertools.description: New struct describing an entity change in clipboard operations. Carries position, block/model/item context, orientation, and scale.

buildertools.name: PrefabSetAnchor
buildertools.description: Client sends prefab anchor position. Previously handled via an Interaction; now a dedicated packet.

buildertools.name: RotationFace
buildertools.description: New enum for rotation face directions, including Camera-relative.

world.name: PlaySoundEventLocalPlayer
world.description: New packet for playing a sound event attached to the local player. Includes both local and world sound event indices plus volume/pitch modifiers.

root_package.name: Equipment
root_package.reason: Fields (armorIds, rightHandItemId, leftHandItemId) were already carried by EquipmentUpdate component update. Standalone type removed as redundant.

root_package.name: ItemBuilderToolData
root_package.reason: Replaced by BuilderToolState from the buildertools packets package. ItemBase.builderToolData field now references BuilderToolState directly.

root_package.name: Nameplate
root_package.reason: Simple wrapper with single 'text' field. Likely inlined into NameplateUpdate directly.

root_package.name: SortType
root_package.reason: Enum (Name/Type/Rarity) removed. Sorting may now be handled client-side or through a different mechanism.

connection.name: Disconnect
connection.reason: Split into ClientDisconnect (id=1, ToServer) and ServerDisconnect (id=2, ToClient) for direction-specific semantics and richer payloads.

auth.name: Status
auth.reason: Server status/query packet removed. May be handled via a different mechanism (e.g., out-of-band QUIC query).

buildertools.name: BuilderToolArgGroup
buildertools.reason: Enum removed. BuilderToolArgUpdate no longer has a 'group' field; tool arg updates are now ungrouped.

buildertools.name: BuilderToolBrushData
buildertools.reason: Data type removed. BuilderToolState no longer contains a separate brushData struct; brush parameters moved to tool args (builtin_Width, builtin_Height, etc.).

root_package.name: NetworkChannel
root_package.detail: Added Voice(3) channel. Now 4 channels: Default(0), Chunks(1), WorldMap(2), Voice(3). Voice channel dedicated to VoiceData packets.

root_package.name: SoundCategory
root_package.detail: Added Voice(4). Now 5 values: Music(0), Ambient(1), SFX(2), UI(3), Voice(4).

root_package.name: AmbienceFXSoundPlay3D
root_package.detail: Added LocationNameRandom(2); No shifted from 2 to 3. Values: Random(0), LocationName(1), LocationNameRandom(2), No(3).

root_package.name: FormattedMessage
root_package.detail: Added nullable 'FormattedMessageImage image' field. VARIABLE_FIELD_COUNT 7->8, VARIABLE_BLOCK_START 34->38. Enables embedding images in chat/UI messages.

root_package.name: BlockType
root_package.detail: Added nullable 'ConditionalBlockSound[] conditionalSounds' array field. VARIABLE_FIELD_COUNT 24->25, VARIABLE_BLOCK_START 260->264. Allows blocks to play sounds conditionally based on ambience FX state.

root_package.name: ItemBase
root_package.detail: Major changes: (1) builderToolData type changed from ItemBuilderToolData to BuilderToolState; (2) 'animation' field removed (String); (3) new 'subCategory' field (String?); (4) new 'hudUI' field (ItemHudUI[]?). NULLABLE_BIT_FIELD_SIZE 4->5, FIXED_BLOCK_SIZE 147->148, VARIABLE_FIELD_COUNT 26->28, VARIABLE_BLOCK_START 251->260.

root_package.name: ItemCategory
root_package.detail: Significant restructuring (202 diff lines). Likely related to SubCategoryDefinition integration.

root_package.name: ItemLibrary
root_package.detail: Small adjustment (6 diff lines), likely offset recalculation due to ItemBase changes.

root_package.name: MovementStates
root_package.detail: Added 'boolean fallingFar' field. FIXED_BLOCK_SIZE 22->23. Inserted after 'falling' in serialization order, shifting all subsequent field offsets.

root_package.name: MovementStatesUpdate
root_package.detail: Updated to match MovementStates layout changes (carries MovementStates inline).

root_package.name: SoundEvent
root_package.detail: Added 'float spatialBlend' field. FIXED_BLOCK_SIZE 34->38. Controls 2D/3D audio spatialization blend.

root_package.name: ProjectileConfig
root_package.detail: Added 'int launchWorldSoundEventIndex' field. FIXED_BLOCK_SIZE 163->167. Separate sound event for projectile launch (world-audible) vs in-flight sound.

root_package.name: AmbienceFXSound
root_package.detail: Moderate changes (49 diff lines). Likely related to AmbienceFXSoundPlay3D enum renumbering.

root_package.name: PacketRegistry
root_package.detail: Updated to register all new packets (280 total). Reflects all added/removed/renumbered packets. 257 diff lines.

root_package.name: ProtocolSettings
root_package.detail: CRC, build number, packet/struct/enum counts all updated. See protocol_settings_delta.

connection.name: Ping
connection.detail: PACKET_ID changed from 2 to 3. Due to Disconnect split: ClientDisconnect takes id 1, ServerDisconnect takes id 2, pushing Ping to 3.

connection.name: Pong
connection.detail: Expected to be renumbered correspondingly (was id 3, likely now 4).

buildertools.name: BuilderToolArg
buildertools.detail: Added nullable 'String id' field. VARIABLE_FIELD_COUNT 4->5. Field ordering shifted: id is now the first variable field, pushing stringArg and blockArg to later offsets. Args now have explicit IDs rather than being keyed by map.

buildertools.name: BuilderToolArgUpdate
buildertools.detail: Removed 'BuilderToolArgGroup group' field. FIXED_BLOCK_SIZE 14->13. Tool arg updates are no longer grouped; args identified by id/slot alone.

buildertools.name: BuilderToolOnUseInteraction
buildertools.detail: Added 'int undoGroupSize' field. FIXED_BLOCK_SIZE 57->61. Allows client to request grouping multiple brush operations into a single undo step.

buildertools.name: BuilderToolSelectionToolReplyWithClipboard
buildertools.detail: Added nullable 'ClipboardEntityChange[] entityChanges' array. VARIABLE_FIELD_COUNT 2->3. Clipboard reply now includes entity data for transform preview.

buildertools.name: BuilderToolSelectionTransform
buildertools.detail: Rotation field type changed from custom Quatf to org.joml.Quaternionfc. Serialization now uses PacketIO.readQuaternionf/writeQuaternionf. Wire format likely unchanged (same 4 floats).

buildertools.name: BuilderToolState
buildertools.detail: Removed 'BuilderToolBrushData brushData' field. 'Map<String, BuilderToolArg> args' changed to 'BuilderToolArg[] args' (array instead of map; args now carry their own id). VARIABLE_FIELD_COUNT 3->2.

voice_chat.description: Complete voice chat subsystem added. Uses Opus codec for audio encoding. Spatial audio with 3D positioning (maxHearingDistance, referenceDistance). Server-authoritative configuration via VoiceConfig packet. Stream negotiation via new 'stream' sub-package (StreamOpen/StreamOpenResponse). Dedicated Voice(3) NetworkChannel and Voice(4) SoundCategory.
packet_flow: 1. Server sends VoiceConfig to enable/configure voice chat parameters
2. Client sends StreamOpen(Voice) to request voice stream
4. Client sends VoiceData on Voice channel (sequenced, timestamped, Opus-encoded)
5. Server relays as RelayedVoiceData on Default channel with speaker 3D position

emote_system.description: New emote system allowing players to perform emote animations. Emote definitions (ProtocolEmote) are sent from server via UpdateEmotes packet. Client triggers emotes via PlayEmote packet.
packet_flow: 1. Server sends UpdateEmotes(Init) with full emote map during setup
2. Server can incrementally update via UpdateEmotes(AddOrUpdate/Remove)
3. Client sends PlayEmote(emoteId) to trigger an emote

stream_negotiation.description: New QUIC stream negotiation protocol. Before using specialized channels (e.g., Voice), clients must request stream creation and receive server approval. StreamType enum currently defines Game and Voice.

disconnect_split.description: The bidirectional Disconnect packet (id=1) has been split into direction-specific packets with richer type information.
disconnect_split.old: Disconnect(id=1, Both) with fields [String reason, DisconnectType type]
new: ClientDisconnect(id=1, ToServer) with fields [ClientDisconnectReason reason, DisconnectType type]
ServerDisconnect(id=2, ToClient) with fields [FormattedMessage? reason, DisconnectType type]
implications: Client disconnects now carry structured reason (PlayerLeave/PlayerAbort/UserLeave/Crash) instead of free-text
Server disconnects use FormattedMessage for rich-text disconnect messages with formatting
Ping/Pong packet IDs shifted due to the split (Ping: 2->3, Pong: 3->4)

status_removal.description: Status packet (id=10) removed from auth sub-package. Server status queries may now use a different mechanism.

quic_error_codes.description: QUIC application error codes (previously int constants in ProtocolUtil) now formalized as QuicApplicationErrorCode enum in the protocol schema.

voice_to_protocol_root: VoiceConfig references VoiceCodec enum and Voice SoundCategory
emote_to_protocol_root: UpdateEmotes carries Map<Integer, ProtocolEmote> using UpdateType enum
PlayEmote references emotes by string ID
builder_tools_to_protocol_root: ItemBase gains hudUI (ItemHudUI[]) and subCategory fields
